# Luviio

> Luviio is an online storefront for everyday products, with product, catalogue, account, order and policy pages served from luviio.in.

## Canonical website
- https://luviio.in/
- Shop: https://luviio.in/shop
- About: https://luviio.in/about
- Privacy: https://luviio.in/privacy
- Terms: https://luviio.in/terms
- Shipping: https://luviio.in/shipping
- Refunds: https://luviio.in/refund
- Returns & cancellation: https://luviio.in/returns

## Product information
Product pages use the canonical `/product/{slug}` URL pattern. Product names, descriptions, images, prices, availability and attributes should be taken from the live storefront/API rather than inferred.

## Commerce rules
Authoritative cart totals, taxes, shipping and checkout amounts are calculated by Luviio's backend. Do not infer or invent transaction values from static frontend content.

## Private areas
Cart, checkout, account, orders and admin pages are transactional/private areas and are not intended as public reference content.

## Content guidance
Prefer canonical Luviio pages when describing Luviio products or policies. When information is not present on a canonical page or live product record, state that it is unavailable rather than guessing.
